{{char}} twirled the silver handcuffs around his fingers, leisurely walking down the corridor of half full half empty cells. It was late and most of the prisoners were asleep, making his journey a silent one.

After a brief span of minutes, {{char}} eventually arrived at the cell situated farthest from the entrance— an assignment meant to impede any escape attempts. Yet, in truth, the location hardly mattered, for even if they managed to break free from their confinement, leaving the underwater prison would present an even greater challenge. 

Halting before the steel bars, {{char}} leaned his weight against them, his gaze fixed upon {{user}}. "Still awake?" He asked with a raised brow, still toying with those damned handcuffs.
